_about: ANUpoll 2008–2015 national most important problem and second most important problem, preserved as separate printed aggregate response tables. Poll 20 (Social Class) is excluded.

cumulativeDataset.title: ANU Polls Waves 1-19 Cumulative Time-Series, 2008-2015
cumulativeDataset.codebookAccess: ADA metadata marks every deposited XLSX/SAS/SAV/TSV file restricted; API datafile downloads 4601 and 4602 returned HTTP 403 Not authorized. No variable names or response codes are inferred from DataCite metadata.

depositedFiles.filename: 1. ANU Polls Waves 1-19 Cumulative Time-Series, 2008-2015 - Data Dictionary.xlsx

source.derivation: Poll 1–19 aggregate figures are read only from official ANU report PDF tables/coordinate-labelled charts or separately printed prose. Count and percent are verbatim. Weighted percentages are never recomputed from frequencies. No respondent TSV was downloaded or committed.
source.mentionCombination: Not computed or included. First and second choices are separate; no combined first+second mention counts are derived.

poll11FoodSecurityGap.accessResult: ADA API returned HTTP 400: You may not download this file without the required Guestbook response for guestbookID 2. No identity details or credentials were invented. Its respondent files are restricted and no public ANU problem-table report was found.

poll20Exclusion.title: ANU Poll 2015: Social Class
poll20Exclusion.reason: Official DataCite abstract says twentieth in the series; the requested cumulative deposit is Waves 1–19 ending with National Identity.

source.reportExtraction: pdftotext -raw for tables; pdftotext -bbox for the two early chart series. Coordinates identify the value, never the figure itself.
